# Monetization Playbook

Use this playbook to align monetization with maturity stage.

## Principle

Monetization strategy should match product certainty:
- Phase 1: Validate value and behavior
- Phase 2: Validate willingness to pay
- Phase 3: Optimize for margin and scale

## Phase-Based Monetization

## Phase 1: Proof

Objective:
- Prove a repeated user problem and engagement loop

Recommended posture:
- Free access or very light pilot fees
- Do not over-optimize pricing this early

Signals to collect:
- Retention and repeat use
- Activation completion
- User-perceived value statements

## Phase 2: Defensibility

Objective:
- Introduce monetization with low friction

Recommended options:
- Transaction fee
- Subscription starter tier
- Service convenience fee
- Premium workflow add-on

Signals to collect:
- Conversion to paid
- Churn reasons
- Price objections and elasticity

## Phase 3: Scale

Objective:
- Improve unit economics and predictability

Recommended options:
- Tiered subscription model
- Margin optimization by segment
- Partner/referral channels
- B2B or enterprise packaging

Signals to collect:
- Gross margin trend
- CAC payback period
- Net revenue retention

## Revenue Stream Menu (Pick by Model)

- Marketplace: Take rate + promoted listings + verification fees
- SaaS: Tiered plans + usage overage + add-ons
- Fintech: Transaction spread + interchange + premium account
- Creator platform: Subscription + tips + sponsored distribution
- Services hybrid: Setup fee + recurring service + premium support

## Pricing Test Template

| Hypothesis | Segment | Price Point | Offer | Success Metric | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [H1] | [User type] | [Amount] | [Offer] | [Conversion target] | [ ] |
| [H2] | [User type] | [Amount] | [Offer] | [Churn target] | [ ] |

## Guardrails

- Avoid complex pricing in Phase 1
- Do not scale paid acquisition before conversion fundamentals are clear
- Link pricing changes to measurable experiments
